briefing.geography: Two lit yards flank one unlit north-south corridor.
goals: Hold through wave 12 while the decoy shed draws the migration.
rules: Moths choose light by radius; the Decoy Shed counts double and takes 6 damage per attached swarm each second.
Darkness is a road: non-moths move 12% faster outside light below 35% coverage.
The cycle stays at night, easing only through two-second dusks.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.

Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.
Light radius 7; moth target score is coverage x radius x 1.
Light radius 11 with target weight 2; takes 6 damage per attached swarm each second.
